en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “One who knows the excellence of an elderly person and honors him, Allah, the Mighty and Sublime will grant him salvation from fear on the Day of Judgment.”
And he said, “Respecting an elderly believer is a way of showing respect to Allah, the Mighty and Sublime.”
